title: Still waiting for Slab’s next update?
intro: Outline is the open source alternative to Slab with new features every month, so your team’s knowledge base keeps getting better – on-premises or in the cloud.

highlights.title: Shipping every month.
highlights.description: Since Slab’s last product update in July 2025, Outline has shipped split view, present mode, toggle blocks, PDF embeds, a built-in MCP server and more.

highlights.title: Built in public.
highlights.description: Outline’s code is on GitHub with hundreds of contributors, so you can see exactly what’s being worked on and where it’s heading.

highlights.title: Your data, your choice.
highlights.description: Run Outline in our cloud or on your own servers, and export everything as Markdown, HTML, or JSON at any time.

features.title: Great looking docs, without even trying.
features.description: An easy to use editor with markdown shortcuts, slash commands, and media embeds that looks great by default.

features.title: Access control & permissions.
features.description: Manage access with read & write permissions, user groups, guest users, public sharing, and more – on every plan.

features.title: Structured & instantly searchable.
features.description: Nest documents in a hierarchy, automatically build a network of backlinks and search across everything in ms.

features.title: AI answers & built-in MCP.
features.description: Get instant answers from your knowledge base, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants to search, read, and edit docs with the built-in MCP server.

features.title: Cloud hosted or on-premises.
features.description: Outline is available as a cloud hosted service that’s always up-to-date or as a self-hosted install on your own network. Slab is available only in the cloud.

migration.title: Bring your Slab content with you
migration.description: Export your Slab workspace and import it into Outline in a single step. Formatting, images, and links between documents are preserved, and the folder structure is recreated as collections.

faq.question: Is Slab still being updated?
faq.answer: Slab’s most recent product announcement was in July 2025. Outline has shipped new features every month since then, and every change is visible in the public changelog and on GitHub.

faq.question: Can I move my content from Slab?
faq.answer: Yes. Export your Slab workspace and import it from Outline’s settings. Formatting, images, and links between documents come across, and the folder structure is recreated as collections.

faq.question: Can I self-host Outline instead?
faq.answer: Yes. Outline can be installed on your own network. Slab is only available as a cloud service.

closing: Ready to move from Slab? Get started in minutes…
